risk_note: F1-08bc (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 ②, D10-1712, D10-1816; landed per D10-1772, stacked on #189 F1-08bb and rebased onto main). Payout queue 录入企业支付宝余额 / 录入运营账户余额 for fund.cash_entry: amount and measured-at time, SMS step-up, adminCreatePayoutWatermark; the measured-at time is checked as the contract says and 20001 data.fields is shown; amounts only through @couli/money; an unknown write result is retried only with the original key and body (D10-1731). Frozen cases (same as D10-1733): F1-08ba READONLY#1 and F1-08bb ACCESS#1 only change the super-admin write-entry list to exactly the landed entries (modify_existing, ledger #194); per D10-1816 each of the two files gets one new it block ([AC-F1-08bc-FROZEN#1]/[#2]) using only that file's existing imports and helpers, nothing outside the blocks changed. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by independent Claude contexts in three rounds; spec-test: r1 fail, r2 pass, r3 (approvals #96) of the two new blocks only, pass. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); couli-ci verify:fast and --browser green after the rebase and the new blocks. Written by hand.
